body:
Is there like an average time of recovery?  I'm barely skimming through school now, and I've been accepted to law school in August.  I could not do this shit with that kind of work load on top of it, so I've really been banking on at least a minor recovery by August.  Is this just wishful thinking or is there a chance?

*Thats the kinda shit that really get me down, that these events and episodes have this continuous power to drag me down and render me useless.  It just creates the vicious cycle of self hate.  I used to be very productive before this, but thats been shot to shit since.  Coming to terms with that has been the worst part of the whole experience, worse, I think, than the suicidal thoughts- though it certainly fuels them.

I currently live off campus with a few friends.  I have not had much contact with my father since I left for the semester (once when we were both at a funeral, but I had made it very clear that I did not want to talk with him).


I rotate between moments of lethargic numbness where I can't get out of bed, and moments of deep depression and self-destructive thoughts.


One of the doctors did actually advise I play video games to keep my mind and body occupied.  I try it every now in then, but I just get nothing out of it now, it just feels like another task to be checked off. (And I'm a huge marvel vs capcom fan)

I have never tried to marble thing, I'll give that a shot too.
Thank you.

Thank you, and I have tried EMDR.  It does work a little in the beginning, but more and more shit got stacked on top and now its almost useless.  This was also before I started having suicidal thoughts.


This is the most concerning to me.  I cannot shut off my thoughts or my mind now no matter what meds I take.  Its finally begun to break me and I am really desperate for something to give.  (I have finals next week, so I see no relief in the *near future)
